tabs.label: Einladen
tabs.instructions: These phrases invite someone. The first group is formal, the second informal.
text:
• Gehen Sie am Freitag mit ins Theater? – Are you coming to the theatre on Friday? (formal)
  • Gehen wir am Samstag ins Kino? – Shall we go to the cinema on Saturday? (informal)
  • Kommst du mit? – Are you coming? (informal)

tabs.label: Zusagen
tabs.instructions: To say yes, keep it short and warm.
text:
• Ja, gern! – Yes, gladly!
  • Das ist eine gute Idee. – That is a good idea.
  • Prima, bis Samstag! – Great, see you on Saturday!

tabs.label: Absagen
tabs.instructions: To say no politely, give a short reason and offer another day. Say “leider” or “tut mir leid” first.
text:
• Leider nicht, ich arbeite am Freitag. – Unfortunately not, I am working on Friday.
  • Tut mir leid, ich habe keine Zeit. – I am sorry, I do not have time.
  • Und am Sonntag? – And on Sunday?
